source_note: Captured live 2026-10-11 at 1920x1080 (arcade Mortal Kombat, 1992). Replaces a web-image entry that never matched the real game.
roi_reason: Title plus the top row of portraits (2026-10-11): the pixel-art title alone shimmers under the TV filter (distance 34 between two live frames); with the portraits it is 14, wherever the selection box is.

selection_grid.what: Player 1's green selection box. The game prints no fighter names on this screen, so the name comes from which portrait the box surrounds.

notes: Grid: JOHNNY CAGE, KANO, (dragon emblem), SUB-ZERO, SONYA on top; RAIDEN, LIU KANG, SCORPION below. Validated live 2026-10-11 by moving through all seven. A countdown auto-picks the highlighted fighter after about ten seconds.
